desc: Classic, laid-back spot offering Punjabi cuisine, vegetarian dishes & village-style seating.
addr: 329, 10th A Main Rd, Jaya Nagar 1st Block, Jayanagar East, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011, India

rev.t: Visited July 2026 for a friend's reunion. The food was excellent. Taste was nice and portions were healthy. We tried frird sweet corn, panneer Tikka for starters and then kaju Masala, Dal fry and bhindi sabji with pulkas. The bhindi was …

Amazing north Indian food. All kinds of naans and rotis were amazing. Gravies were distinct and very delicious. Loved every bite. Specially lesuni paratha. All kinds of paneer were good. There are two seating options available, either sit on the cot or seat on table and chair/benches
Kapoor's cafe serves delicious punjabi food. All the items tastes soo good and flavorful. Be it starter's or main course, taste will never disappoint you. You will definitely enjoy all the dishes. …
